## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed internals with Financials/Healthcare registering broad strength while Technology shows both strong winners (AAPL, AVGO) and large laggards (AMAT, LRCX, INTC), and Top-5 leadership is narrow → Caution on conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.96% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing breadth: GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +11.60%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: SHW (1W: -4.05% | 1M: +10.84%) CORRECTION, PPG (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +2.73%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary/Industrials under pressure with TSLA (1W: -4.41% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND and CAT (1W: -5.35% | 1M: +2.48%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: OXY (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -8.59%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +7.32% | 1M: -19.32%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology, 2/5 Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SHW (1W: -4.05% | 1M: +10.84%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -4.12% | 1M: +11.63%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -4.41% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -5.35% | 1M: +2.48%) CORRECTION, PPG (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +2.73%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: OXY (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -8.59%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND; watch major divergence in Tech (several large-cap semis and chips with strong 1M but heavy 1W selling) — MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed / tactical: AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND, but AMAT (1W: -9.56% | 1M: +19.61%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: -9.74% | 1M: +8.93%) CORRECTION and INTC (1W: -11.40% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth: 12/24 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Constructive: SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND — Financials breadth: 14/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive-to-constructive: GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +11.60%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare breadth: 13/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to select Financials and Energy names showing consistent 1M+ confirmation (SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor Tech winners (AAPL, AVGO) while reducing exposure to high-volatility chip names and TSLA (TSLA (1W: -4.41% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND — bullish news confirmed; SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation.  
BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -9.56% | 1M: +19.61%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -11.40% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION — risk of deeper pullback; watch TSLA (1W: -4.41% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (breadth: 8/10 positive) and Financials (breadth: 14/20 positive).  
BEARISH: Materials (breadth: 4/11 positive) and Industrials (breadth: 6/15 positive) where recent 1W weakness suggests profit-taking.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY — watch 1W support/resume above near-term pivot for confirmation.  
AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND — monitor pullback support near recent consolidation.  
JPM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND — continued 1M strength would signal Financials leadership persistence.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
GILD (+80): Gilead approvals — GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
PFE (+70): FDA maintenance approval narrative — PFE (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY — bullish news but 1M negative, divergence.  
UNH (+50): raised guidance chatter — UNH (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-65): EU regulatory headline — META (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price rising (divergence).  
HD (-50): skepticism on core business — HD (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines align with 1W weakness and a correction pattern.  
MDT (-75): recall risk (news) — monitor Medtronic closely (news severe); if 1W weakness appears this would confirm downside risk (price data not in summary for dual timeframe here).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND and PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE in Tech (large-cap semis and chips selling while some mega-cap techs rally) and negative headlines on META despite price strength — watch for trend confirmation.
